title: Advancements in Content-Based Image Retrieval: A Comprehensive Survey of Relevance Feedback Techniques
abstract: arXiv:2312.10089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) systems have emerged as crucial tools in the field of computer vision, allowing for image search based on visual content rather than relying solely on metadata. This survey paper presents a comprehensive overview of CBIR, emphasizing its role in object detection and its potential to identify and retrieve visually similar images based on content features. Challenges faced by CBIR systems, including the semantic gap and scalability, are discussed, along with potential solutions. It elaborates on the semantic gap, which arises from the disparity between low-level features and high-level semantic concepts, and explores approaches to bridge this gap. One notable solution is the integration of relevance feedback (RF), empowering users to provide feedback on retrieved images and refine search results iteratively. translated_title: 基于内容的图像检索进展：相关反馈技术的综合综述
translated_abstract: 基于内容的图像检索（CBIR）系统已成为计算机视觉领域的关键工具，允许基于视觉内容而非仅依赖元数据进行图像搜索。本综述论文全面概述了CBIR，强调其在目标检测中的作用以及基于内容特征识别和检索视觉相似图像的潜力。文中讨论了CBIR系统面临的挑战，包括语义鸿沟和可扩展性，并探讨了潜在解决方案。它详细阐述了语义鸿沟，即由低级特征与高级语义概念之间的差异产生的问题，并探索了弥合这一鸿沟的方法。一个显著的解决方案是集成相关反馈（RF），使用户能够对检索到的图像提供反馈并迭代优化搜索结果。该综述涵盖了利用RF的长期和短期学习方法。
tldr: 这篇综述全面梳理了基于内容的图像检索系统，重点探讨了通过相关反馈技术来弥合语义鸿沟和提升检索性能的创新方法。
en_tdlr: This survey comprehensively reviews content-based image retrieval systems, highlighting innovative relevance feedback techniques to bridge the semantic gap and enhance retrieval performance.
